prerequisites: Competencies taught in the Algorithms and Data Structures module are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to apply skills in algorithm design and knowledge of the most important design and analysis paradigms.
Can use efficient data structures in algorithm design.
Are able to analyze algorithms regarding correctness and effort.
Have practiced scientific working methods (recognizing, formulating, solving problems, abstraction).
Have trained to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Runtime analysis (worst-case, amortized, output-sensitive, solving recurrences)
Algorithms and data structures for sets, graphs, text, geometric problems, and compression

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Oral examination (individual examination) or written examination

assessment_rules: The grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Data Science degree program. To acquire the ECTS credits, students must achieve at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The examination performance is either an oral examination or a written examination.
